products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic Carrots & Peas
products.description: This classic duo features vibrant carrots and sweet peas grown on certified biodynamic farms. By following Demeter standards, Clearspring ensures the vegetables are nutrient-dense and bursting with natural flavor. This mix is an excellent source of beta-carotene (Vitamin A) and dietary fiber, promoting healthy vision and gut wellness. Perfectly steamed and ready to use, they add colorful nutrition to stews and rice dishes.

products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic Chickpeas
products.description: These plump, creamy chickpeas are grown using biodynamic methods that prioritize soil vitality and biodiversity. Sourced from trusted Demeter farms, they are packed in water without any hidden additives or preservatives. As a fantastic source of plant-based protein and iron, they help maintain energy levels and muscle health. High in fiber, these chickpeas are perfect for making creamy hummus, hearty stews, or protein-rich salads.

products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic French Beans
products.description: Sourced from biodynamic farms, these crisp French beans are harvested at their peak and packed in water to retain their firm texture. The Demeter certification ensures they are grown in harmony with nature for superior quality. Low in calories but rich in Vitamin K and manganese, they are essential for bone health. These versatile beans are a convenient, additive-free addition to any balanced meal.

products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic Garden Peas
products.description: These tender garden peas are preserved in spring water with a pinch of sea salt to maintain their fresh, sweet flavor. Sourced from biodynamic farms following strict Demeter standards, they represent the pinnacle of sustainable agriculture. Naturally high in Vitamin C and fiber, they support a healthy immune system and smooth digestion. Enjoy them straight from the jar in salads, soups, or sides.

products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic Lentils
products.description: Clearspring’s brown lentils are carefully sourced from biodynamic farms where traditional crop rotation keeps the soil rich and healthy. These tender pulses are packed in spring water, offering an earthy flavor and satisfying texture. They are an exceptional source of folate and plant-based protein, supporting heart health and blood function. High in fiber and low in fat, they are a nutritious foundation for soups and plant-based bolognese.

products.name: Clearspring Demeter Organic Sauerkraut
products.description: This traditional Sauerkraut is made using only Demeter-certified organic white cabbage and sea salt, naturally fermented to create a tangy, crisp superfood. Sourced from sustainable European farms, this raw product is never pasteurized to protect its beneficial live cultures. High in Vitamin C and natural probiotics, it is a digestive powerhouse that supports gut health. Add it to salads or sandwiches for a zesty probiotic boost.
